classification_definitions.accepted_v2_5_complete: Canonical Collector 2.5 complete artifact with valid inline 1.0.0 completion evidence.

classification_definitions.historical_disappeared_quarantine: Historical data artifact removed from canonical placement and preserved in quarantine.
